verify.summary: Independent AC010 verification: repository/realtime tests, migration graph, mypy128, lint and separate immutable-snapshot/no-reselection probe passed.
Root standalone owner closes durable gallery publication after independent PASS; media/client remain in FT005.

constraints: Constitution I/III: implement only the accepted additive delta using existing owners and helpers. No deployment or production probe.
Preserve public phone commons restricted to matched dates; the all-dates rule is Promo-only.

Actual runtime storage is face_moment.promo_sessions.gallery_photos; primary owner and orchestration stay in promo. The entrypoint only binds and serializes the existing authenticated application result.
Choose the next available sequential Alembic filename and execution-time direct predecessor; 0033_promo_session_gallery.py is advisory. No historical backfill or default-database downgrade.
Reuse TASK-140 selection as a dependency; proof here owns only publication/integration, not selection-algorithm claims.
invariants: The first four teaser IDs, complete union/N, search gates, QR ticket/expiry and ACK semantics remain unchanged.
Commons never make an insufficient personal result successful and never enter union/N.
title: Persist and publish the optional Promo gallery
purpose: Publish the initial selected gallery as durable session truth so repeat/replay does not reselect photos.
success_outcome: The original realtime result and terminal repeat carry the same stored ordered gallery_photos while historical null-gallery sessions retain their previous response and all baseline session values remain unchanged.
anti_goals: No gallery HTTP-media implementation or client behavior; FT-005 owns those.
No auth, token, permission, QR secret, browser-access or first-slide ACK behavior changes.
Do not rerun selection, mutate issued arrays or refresh the gallery on terminal repeat.

forbidden_scope: FT-005 gallery media and browser UI implementation
Foreign-owner table writes or cross-owner cascades
stop_conditions: Implementation requires a non-additive or irreversible migration, security-policy change or new owner.

verification_targets: FT-004-AC-010: start a unique disposable PostgreSQL database with a seeded historical session immediately before the new linear migration. Upgrade, read/write gallery through PromoSessionRepository, downgrade/re-upgrade, and compare historical ticket/expiry/union/N/teasers. Verify direct down_revision and project linear topology without a mutable exact-head assertion; drop only the probe database after success/failure.

FT-004-AC-010: execute initial result and terminal repeat through the current-source realtime path; change available inventory between calls and use call counters to prove no second search or selection, byte-equivalent ordered gallery entries/URLs, unchanged baseline fields and no new session. Inject publication write failure to prove no half-issued gallery/session. Historical null-gallery repeat omits gallery_photos.
evidence_required: FT-004-AC-010 RED: baseline repository/realtime probe omits the accepted durable gallery; GREEN: disposable migration/repository and realtime proof returns persisted identical photo_id/kind/media_url order on terminal repeat, preserves historical null rows and baseline session truth, and rolls back injected publication failure. Decisive comparison: database snapshots plus initial/repeat JSON and search/selection counts; artifact: focused pytest transcript under .tasks/TASK-141-T2-FT-004-W8/.
